notes.title: Dungeon Alpha Demo
notes.notes:
This is an alpha version of the location, it may have some raw content, but we want to know how should we improve this area. Controller support will be added in the next demo. Please leave a comment what keyboard control scheme is more addictive to you.

We would like to thank all our followers, and we are working hard to improve the game.

notes.title: Dev diary
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Thanks to our fans and followers for the supporting Ami game! It's very important to our team.

We are working hard on some new locations and game mechanics.
A new extended demo is planned early next year, it should reveal the game from new angle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36642119/d4eb884287638cb59604b57700956fc8f36dc635.gif[/img]

We have created a new starting location that will unfold in the abandoned subway station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36642119/5236011295f913cc9eb062d60db3abe2fa90dc14.gif[/img]

Also Ami will have to explore an mysterious mansion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36642119/458d6cb5c617ea5dee2511cd21b8cec091daddd5.gif[/img]

The forest location was expanded and contains several new puzzles and mechanics. 

We will keep you informed about next major updates.
